name: CaseFlexDirectionByAxis
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "flex-direction-by-axis" (layout). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: flex-direction that VARIES on one enum axis (column at the default value, row on the other) — the fluent.card orientation shape
